title: Geometric regularity of the generic fibre of a characteristic-zero DVR completion
statement: Let A be a discrete valuation ring and let K be a characteristic-zero fraction field of A. Let B be the maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. The generic fibre (zero prime).Fiber B [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is geometrically regular over (zero prime).ResidueField in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PX, proof of (3) and (4), expanded into the generic and closed fibre calculations; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PX

proof.text: Install the domain and DVR structures on B using [lem-weil-pbc-completion-of-dvr-is-dvr]. The completion maximal ideal is the image of that of A by [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring].

The residue field k at zero is a fraction field of A. Apply the proved source-library lemma IsDiscreteValuationRing.isFractionRing_tensorProduct to the maximal-ideal equality, obtaining IsFractionRing B (B tensor_A k). This lemma composes [lem-weil-pbc-localization-base-change] with the uniformizer argument [lem-weil-pbc-dvr-unit-times-uniformizer-power]. Swap tensor factors to identify the generic fibre with this field.

Transport characteristic zero from K to A by natural-cast injectivity and then to k by the fraction-field lemma. Every finite purely inseparable extension kprime of k has bijective algebraMap by [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] and separability in characteristic zero. The includeRight map to kprime tensor_k fibre is therefore bijective. Transport regularity from the field fibre across this ring equivalence by [lem-weil-pbc-field-regular-ring]. Field Noetherianity and these regular base changes give [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
